Defining Temperament & Appearance: Dynamic, athletic build, direct gaze, quick movements.
Approach to Life & Key Focus: The Pioneer. Impulsive, courageous, fiercely independent. Focuses on starting projects and blazing new trails. Prone to accidents involving the head.

Defining Temperament & Appearance: Sturdy build, beautiful features, magnetic eyes, calm and slow demeanor.
Approach to Life & Key Focus: The Sustainer. Stable, practical, sensual, and focused on security and comfort. Values family, wealth, and material luxury. Resistant to rapid change.

Defining Temperament & Appearance: Tall, slender, animated expression, restless eyes, youthful appearance.
Approach to Life & Key Focus: The Communicator. Intellectual, curious, social, and prone to multitasking. Life's purpose involves learning, writing, and communication; often has a dual personality.

Defining Temperament & Appearance: Round face, soft features, watery eyes, moderate height.
Approach to Life & Key Focus: The Nurturer. Emotional, sensitive, and deeply attached to home and family. Highly intuitive. Approach is protective, cautious, and seeks emotional security above all.

Defining Temperament & Appearance: Robust or tall build, broad shoulders, commanding presence, confident walk.
Approach to Life & Key Focus: The Leader. Proud, charismatic, and seeks recognition and authority. Natural leadership abilities. Focuses on creative self-expression and being the center of attention.

Defining Temperament & Appearance: Slender, neat, clean-cut, delicate features, sometimes shy or reserved.
Approach to Life & Key Focus: The Analyzer. Practical, analytical, and highly service-oriented. Focuses energy on details, perfection, health, and solving practical problems for others. Can be overly critical.

Defining Temperament & Appearance: Well-proportioned, often beautiful or graceful, charming smile, diplomatic manner.
Approach to Life & Key Focus: The Harmonizer. Driven by relationship, fairness, and balance. Approach is diplomatic and seeks partnership in all areas. Avoids conflict and prioritizes social harmony.

Defining Temperament & Appearance: Intense eyes, penetrating gaze, strong, compact body.
Approach to Life & Key Focus: The Transformer. Deeply passionate, secretive, and resilient. Life path involves dealing with crisis, transformation, and hidden knowledge (occult, research, psychology). Extremely determined.

Defining Temperament & Appearance: Tall, athletic build, cheerful expression, broad forehead.
Approach to Life & Key Focus: The Explorer. Optimistic, philosophical, adventurous, and freedom-loving. Seeks higher knowledge, travel, and spiritual growth. Can be restless and overly blunt.

Defining Temperament & Appearance: Lean build, serious expression, disciplined posture.
Approach to Life & Key Focus: The Builder. Ambitious, practical, disciplined, and focused on achievement. Values responsibility and long-term goals. Can appear reserved or overly cautious.

Defining Temperament & Appearance: Distinctive features, unconventional style, thoughtful gaze.
Approach to Life & Key Focus: The Visionary. Innovative, humanitarian, eccentric, and intellectual. Seeks reform and progress. Can be emotionally detached or unpredictable.

Defining Temperament & Appearance: Gentle features, dreamy eyes, soft and compassionate appearance.
Approach to Life & Key Focus: The Dreamer. Imaginative, empathetic, spiritual, and artistic. Seeks emotional connection and transcendence. Can be escapist or overly idealistic.
